The healing instance of the same identity, applied by the sequential survival walk: applied_amount = min(amount, max_health - current_health); overheal = amount - applied_amount; applied_amount + overheal = amount.

step2_reproducing_the_heal_amounts_from_.method: Deathbringer Stance heal = 1.0 x post-mitigation bonus magic damage x 2.0 (World Ender rank 3). Umbral Dash heal = 0.16 x the same post-mitigation damage x 2.0.
step2_reproducing_the_heal_amounts_from_.records_36_37: Umbral Dash vamp on the preceding damage event of the same swing (trigger ids ...:10, vs ...:11 for records [38]-[41]); amounts 31.8 / 31.4 taken as committed and unmoved.
step2_reproducing_the_heal_amounts_from_.conclusion: Four of the six same-timestamp amounts -- including the record under adjudication -- reproduce to the displayed decimal from cached wiki text alone. `amount` = 359.4 is INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CORRECT and is not what moved. Any candidate split must therefore sum to 359.4.

step3_pinning_the_missing_health_before_.constraint_A: Records [40] and [41] both have applied_amount 0.0 and are UNMOVED. Under the clipping identity that means the target's remaining room is exactly 0 once [39] has landed, i.e. record [39] consumed ALL remaining room: applied[39] = room_before_39, and the target sits at exactly max_health 2588 at t=4.31+ under BOTH candidate values.
step3_pinning_the_missing_health_before_.constraint_B: Because the target is at exactly 2588 immediately after [39] under both candidates, the entire post-t=4.31 segment of the health walk is identical under both. The two candidates therefore differ ONLY in the target's health at t=4.31-: old => 2588-614.7 = 1973.3 ; new => 2588-554.3 = 2033.7, a 60.4 difference.
step3_pinning_the_missing_health_before_.constraint_C: Whole-fight closure for a unit that starts full and ends full, with every heal clipped: ending_health = max_health - damage_taken + SUM(applied_healing). Baseline: 2588 = 2588 - 4074.9 + SUM(applied) => SUM(applied) = 4074.9, exactly the recorded healing_received 4074.9. The OLD split satisfies this closure exactly.
step3_pinning_the_missing_health_before_.counterfactual_test_of_the_new_split: Set applied[39] = 211.0 with all 63 other heal records unmoved (the diff population touches only applied_amount and overheal of record [39]; the five same-timestamp siblings are unmoved). Then SUM(applied) = 4074.9 - 60.4 = 4014.5, and the closure gives ending_health = 2588 - 4074.9 + 4014.5 = 2527.6 (ratio 0.977). That contradicts three separately-recorded unmoved facts at once: ending_health 2588, ending_health_ratio 1.0, and healing_received 4074.9. Read the other way: for the target to be only 554.3 short at t=4.31- while taking the same unmoved damage, participants[2]/survival/damage_taken would have to be 4014.5, not the UNMOVED 4074.9.
step3_pinning_the_missing_health_before_.result: missing health at t=4.31- is uniquely m0 = 31.8 + 31.4 + 280.1 + 271.4 = 614.7, i.e. the target stood at 2588 - 614.7 = 1973.3 health when the series began.

step4_the_full_six_heal_clipping_walk.identity: applied = min(amount, 2588 - current_health) ; overheal = amount - applied
cross_checks: The walk reproduces applied 0.0 / overheal 44.8 for [40] and applied 0.0 / overheal 57.5 for [41] -- both UNMOVED records -- with no free parameter left.
The walk reproduces applied = amount, overheal = 0.0 for the three UNMOVED heals [36], [37], [38].
SUM(applied) over the whole fight closes at 4074.9 = damage_taken = healing_received, with the target ending at exactly 2588 / ratio 1.0.
Record [39] is correctly the last heal at the instant to land any health at all: it fills the bar exactly, which is what makes the two records after it fully clipped.

supersedes_prior_briefs.defect: Each of the two leaves was briefed alone as 'one number, old -> new', with no sight of its own record, so neither investigator could see it was adjudicating a SPLIT of one unmoved `amount` rather than a change in the size of a heal.

False premise: `amount`/`raw_amount`/`reduced_amount` are 359.4 on both sides and are not in the qualifying diff population. This receipt additionally re-derives 359.4 from cached wiki text (0.10 x 3001 x 100/167 x 2 = 359.4012), so the heal demonstrably did not grow.
supersedes_prior_briefs.oracle-P4B-leaf29: concluded the SAME heal FELL by 22.3% (applied 271.4 -> 211.0). Same false premise, and mutually exclusive with leaf18: 271.4 + 88.0 = 211.0 + 148.4 = 359.4. The two prior conclusions refute each other before any baseline does.
supersedes_prior_briefs.missing_facts_now_supplied: the record's unmoved `amount` 359.4; the five same-timestamp sibling heals [36]-[38] and [40]-[41] that fix how much room remains when [39] lands; and the healed unit's max_health 2588 -- precisely the facts that make the overheal split computable.
supersedes_prior_briefs.amendment_case: the amendment's named case, 'the fields of a record whose siblings did not move'; escalation owner decision (2) -- re-run with the record's unmoved `amount` in the brief -- is discharged by this receipt.

verdict_rationale: The candidate pair (211.0, 148.4) is arithmetically a VALID split of 359.4, so it is not refutable on the sum identity alone -- which is exactly why the record's siblings are the decisive evidence. It fails on the room. The sequential clipping walk fixes the room available to record [39] at 271.4, because (a) the three preceding UNMOVED heals consume 343.3 of the target's 614.7 missing health, and (b) the two following UNMOVED heals apply 0.0, forcing [39] to have consumed the remainder exactly. Moving 60.4 health from applied to overheal would require the target to have taken 60.4 less damage before t=4.31, contradicting the UNMOVED damage_taken 4074.9, healing_received 4074.9, ending_health 2588 and ending_health_ratio 1.0. The pre-change values are correct; the proposed new values are not.
leaf_specific_reading_of_the_identity: applied_amount is the landed half of the identity: applied = min(amount, max_health - current_health) = min(359.4, 271.4) = 271.4. The proposed 211.0 would leave 60.4 of the target's missing health unhealed while records [40] and [41] still report applied 0.0, and would break the whole-fight closure against the UNMOVED damage_taken 4074.9.
paired_leaf_note: The two leaves are the two halves of ONE clipping identity against ONE unmoved `amount` (359.4); a single recomputation of the t=4.31 heal ordering determines both, and both resolve to old_value_correct.
